title: Resolve BrowserScan Firefox kernel and UA mismatch
description: Current handoff notes identify a P0 fingerprint blocker: BrowserScan browser-checker reported actual Firefox kernel 149 while the claimed UA was Firefox 150 before the managed identity alignment work. Re-run real BrowserScan/BrowsersLeaks style verification after the rebase and keep UA, navigator/buildID, and patched Firefox observable identity coherent.
acceptance_criteria: Real browser QA evidence shows browser-checker kernel and user agent agree; timezone/language/WebRTC checks remain green; no token/proxy/profile secrets are captured in docs, logs, screenshots, or beads notes.
close_reason: No-proxy BrowserScan P0 re-verification passed in a temporary Docker manager: browser-checker reported Firefox 149 and User Agent match; UA is Firefox/149.0; navigator.buildID is 20260521160037; navigator.webdriver=false; WebRTC reported No Public IP Leak with public IP 23.144.4.92 and no local IP text; timezone page reported America/Los_Angeles consistently; bot-detection reported WebDriver/Selenium/Headless/CDP/Dev Tool as Normal. Evidence recorded in docs/ai-docs/v1/tasks/13-regression-release.md.

title: Resolve Pixelscan no-proxy fingerprint inconsistency
description: Pixelscan no-proxy release smoke on invisible-browser-manager:automation-console-redaction reached pixelscan.net/fingerprint-check but reported 'Your Browser Fingerprint is inconsistent'. Low-sensitive diagnostic showed the actual status line plus cards for Browser, Location, Fingerprint, WebRTC IP Address, Timezone from JS, HardwareConcurency, Language, Languages from Javascript, Accept-Language header, and Hardware. IPhey home loaded as Trustworthy, but /leaks returned an edge error page, so the Pixelscan/IPhey gate remains incomplete. Investigate the root cause without storing screenshots, cookies, local storage, headers, tokens, IP values, profile dir contents, or full page text.
acceptance_criteria: No-proxy Pixelscan/IPhey external smoke can be rerun from a temporary Docker manager and proves no IP/timezone/language/WebRTC/hardware/software high-risk inconsistency; diagnostic evidence is low-sensitive only; release checklist and cbim-23h.1 notes are updated; full quality gates are rerun if code changes.

Pixelscan status bar remained error/inconsistent, but DOM showed the only failed checker card was PXLSCN-FINGERPRINT-MASKING with text 'Masking detected Fingerprint'. Proxy, Location, Bot check, language/timezone/WebRTC, and WebGL display values did not show high-risk mismatch; minimal profile without explicit gpu_vendor/gpu_renderer/hardware_concurrency still failed on the same fingerprint masking card. Docker image invisible_playwright is 0.1.0; bundled Firefox application.ini reports Version=150.0.1 and BuildID=20260521160037, while Manager intentionally exposes Firefox 149 to match BrowserScan detectable kernel. Current evidence points to underlying patched Firefox / zoom.stealth.* seed-based fingerprint masking, not Manager proxy/GeoIP/language/WebRTC or explicit GPU/hardware pin. Temporary A/B attempts to override stealth seed/canvas noise caused launch failure and are not production candidates. Gate remains incomplete; no screenshots, cookies, local storage, full headers, tokens, IP values, profile dirs, full page text, full URL params, font lists, WebRTC candidates, or audit metadata were stored.
